entity_types.name: charity
entity_types.definition: A registered charity lodging an Annual Information Statement with the ACNC, identified by its ABN; its legal form is not inferred from its name.

entity_types.name: fundraising_authorisation
entity_types.definition: A state or territory fundraising registration/licence number held by a charity, evidenced by a fundraising number column for that jurisdiction.

concepts.definition: The ACNC registration status of the charity as published in the Annual Information Statement, including revocation reasons such as voluntary revocation or double defaulter. This is a charity-regulator status, not a company legal status or a licence status.
values: Voluntarily Revoked Not Entitled To Be A Charity
concepts.why_not_existing: entity.status is a coarse company-lifecycle enum (active/deregistered/in_liquidation/suspended/unknown) owned by business; ACNC charity registration states carry regulator-specific revocation reasons and belong to the charity role, so reuse would change meaning and owner. ext.licence.status is a licence status, not charity registration.

concepts.definition: Flag published by the ACNC indicating whether the charity is a basic religious charity for the reporting year, recorded as y/n in the source.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers ACNC basic religious charity classification; ext.entity.tax_concession covers PBI/HPC/DGR concessions, a different regulatory attribute.

concepts.definition: Flag published by the ACNC indicating whether the charity is an incorporated association, recorded as y/n. This is a self-reported association attribute, not an inference of legal form from the charity name.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept records incorporated-association status; entity legal form is not otherwise modelled and must not be inferred from names.

concepts.definition: State or territory incorporated-association registration number held by the charity, qualified by the jurisdiction whose association-number column supplied it. Values are publisher-formatted strings (e.g. INC9886754, A0005374L) and are not normalised across states.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.entity.prior_registration_number is a single legacy state registration number with no jurisdiction qualifier and no multi-value scope; the ACNC file holds up to eight jurisdiction-specific association numbers per charity, so reuse would lose the jurisdiction and multiplicity. ext.entity.prior_registration_state is a state name, not a number.

concepts.definition: Flag published in the ACNC Annual Information Statement indicating whether the charity conducted any activities during its reporting period, recorded as y/n. A 'n' answer is accompanied by a free-text reason in a separate field and is not evidence the charity is inactive or deregistered.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept records whether a charity conducted activities in its reporting period; dyn.charity.registration_status is a regulator status and ext.entity.sector_tag is an activity tag, so reuse would change meaning and owner.

concepts.definition: Free-text explanation supplied by the charity in its ACNC Annual Information Statement for why it did not conduct activities during the reporting period. Publisher wording is retained verbatim; it is self-reported narrative, not a regulator finding.
source_paths: why charity did not conduct activities
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept holds charity self-reported narrative reasons for inactivity; ext.licence.authorisation_text is licence authorisation text owned by the licence role, so reuse would change meaning and owner.

concepts.definition: Free-text description supplied by the charity in its ACNC Annual Information Statement of how it pursued its charitable purposes during the reporting period. Self-reported narrative retained verbatim, not a regulator classification or an ANZSIC activity code.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.entity.sector_tag is a short source-stated tag with a scheme qualifier, not a full narrative description of how purposes were pursued; ext.entity.industry_code is a reviewed crosswalk code. Reuse would change meaning and granularity.

concepts.definition: Flag published in the ACNC Annual Information Statement indicating whether the charity undertook international activities by operating overseas including programs during the reporting period, recorded as y/n.
source_paths: international activities undertaken - operating overseas including programs
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.entity.operating_region and ext.entity.operating_country describe where a business says it operates, not a charity's self-reported international-activity flag; reuse would change owner, meaning and units (region/country values versus y/n).

concepts.definition: Flag published in the ACNC Annual Information Statement indicating whether the charity undertook international activities by transferring goods or services overseas during the reporting period, recorded as y/n.
source_paths: international activities undertaken - transferring goods or services overseas
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept captures a charity's self-reported goods/services transfer overseas flag; ext.entity.operating_country is a country value owned by business, so reuse would change meaning, owner and units.

concepts.definition: Flag published in the ACNC Annual Information Statement indicating whether the charity undertook other international activities not covered by the operating-overseas or goods/services-transfer categories during the reporting period, recorded as y/n.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers a residual 'other international activities' flag for a charity; the existing operating-region/country concepts are business-owned location values, not y/n activity flags.

concepts.definition: Free-text description supplied by the charity in its ACNC Annual Information Statement of the international activities it undertook during the reporting period. Self-reported narrative retained verbatim; it does not by itself establish a country of operation.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.entity.operating_country is a single country value owned by business; this is charity-owned free-text narrative that may mention several places without being a structured country claim, so reuse would change meaning, owner and units.

concepts.definition: Free-text description supplied by the charity in its ACNC Annual Information Statement of the 'other' international activities it undertook during the reporting period. Self-reported narrative retained verbatim.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept holds charity-owned free-text describing residual international activities; ext.entity.operating_country is a structured business-owned country value, so reuse would change meaning, owner and units.

concepts.definition: Publisher-assigned fundraising registration or licence number held by a charity for a specific Australian state or territory, taken verbatim from that jurisdiction's fundraising-number column. Formats differ by jurisdiction (e.g. CH2136, CCP2996, C/10450, FR0017060, CFN/26748) and are not normalised across states; a placeholder value such as 00000 is retained as published and is not evidence of a valid registration.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.licence.number is owned by the licence role and identifies a business-held licence; a state fundraising registration is owned by the fundraising_authorisation role and is jurisdiction-qualified, so reuse would change owner and meaning. dyn.charity.state_association_number is an incorporated-association number, a different registration regime, and is owned by charity.

concepts.definition: Publisher-recorded y/n flag from the ACNC Annual Information Statement indicating whether the charity reported fundraising activity in a given jurisdiction or online, qualified by the jurisdiction (or 'online' for the national online-fundraising column). A 'y' flag is a self-reported activity indicator and does not by itself prove a registration number exists.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept records a charity's per-jurisdiction or online fundraising activity flag; ext.licence.authorisation is licence-owned authorisation text, and address.state is a business address state, so reuse would change owner, meaning and units.

concepts.definition: Number of people the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement as staff of a given employment category (full time, part time or casual) for its own reporting period. A headcount of people, not full-time-equivalent staff and not a monetary amount; a reported zero is retained as published and is not evidence of no activity.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept records charity staff headcounts; ext.financial.total_income is a monetary business-owned measure and employee expenses is a money amount, so reuse would change meaning, owner and units. The three columns share one meaning (people per employment category) and differ only by category, so one concept with an employment_category qualifier avoids needless aliases.

concepts.definition: Number of volunteers the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement for its own reporting period. A count of volunteers, distinct from paid staff headcount and from full-time-equivalent staff; a reported zero is retained as published.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers volunteer numbers; dyn.charity.staff_headcount (proposed) covers paid staff by employment category, and volunteers are unpaid and reported in a separate column, so folding them in would change meaning.

concepts.definition: Total full-time-equivalent staff the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement for its own reporting period, expressed as an FTE number of persons (decimal, e.g. 4.14). This is a workload-equivalent measure, not a headcount and not a monetary amount.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept holds an FTE measure; dyn.charity.staff_headcount (proposed) counts people per employment category and cannot represent fractional FTE, so reuse would change units and meaning.

relationships.name: HOLDS_FUNDRAISING_AUTHORISATION
relationships.definition: Charity holds a state or territory fundraising registration evidenced by a fundraising number column for that jurisdiction.

reuse.ext.licence.number: Not reused: owned by the licence role for business-held licences; state fundraising registration numbers belong to the fundraising_authorisation role and require a jurisdiction qualifier.
reuse.ext.licence.authorisation: Not reused: holds licence authorisation text, not a y/n fundraising activity flag.
reuse.address.state: Not reused: describes a business address state, not a fundraising activity indicator or registration jurisdiction.
